statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was billed with CPT code 93271
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that payment is bundled into another service
The costs are included within the global surgical package or a separate comprehensive evaluation and management service rendered on the same date of service
